findings.summary: First screen opens with English letters and investment jargon and nothing about safety; the reader says they would close the page.
Many minus numbers, some in red, in the fund and account lists, with nothing saying whether they are losses or differences.
Long, crowded fund list with coloured labels that mean nothing to the reader; it makes them anxious.
The 'cheapest' recommendation is an unfamiliar company, not the reader's bank, and nothing says why to trust it.
The return is filled in ahead of time at 7% and nothing makes clear it is a guess, so the result may look guaranteed.
Small, pale-grey text on black (e.g. 'לא בחישוב', the explanations under each bank) is hard to read even with glasses.
'−21.8% ב־2022' shown in large letters with no reassuring explanation.
A chart on screen 6 has many lines in similar colours that the reader can't tell apart.
Sliders are used for choosing the amounts; the reader gives no specific problem.
